about: Runtime code of the two contracts whose code differs between the a2b4412 build (v3 as first deployed, e.g. the v3-test record) and the launch-cadence build: forge's deployedBytecode and immutableReferences, from `git archive a2b4412 contracts` built with contracts/foundry.toml (solc 0.8.24, evm cancun, optimizer 200 runs; forge 1.7.1). CcipBaseAdapter, CcipBittensorAdapter, CascadeVault and CascadeTwapOracle are byte-identical in both builds.
